Notes on the old build server
The build server ran for nine years on the same installation. It was replaced twice in planning documents and once in hardware.
The interesting part is the disk: two drives in a mirror, one of which had been silently failing since the spring. The mirror hid it for eight months.
When the machine was finally retired, the replacement job took eleven minutes and one command.
